mapper.select: SELECT r.evaluation_no,r.tenant_id,r.attempt_id,r.request_no,r.order_id,r.member_id,r.channel_code,r.channel_merchant_no,r.amount,r.currency,r.input_hash,r.state,r.decision_id,r.rule_version,r.model_version,r.valid_until,r.requested_at,r.deadline FROM tc_payment_attempt a JOIN tc_payment_risk r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.attempt_id=a.id AND r.evaluation_no=a.risk_evaluation_no WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.merchant_request_no=#{request} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_payment_attempt SET risk_evaluation_no=#{evaluation},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merchant_request_no=#{request}

UPDATE tc_payment_risk SET state=#{state},decision_id=#{decision},rule_version=#{rule},model_version=#{model},valid_until=#{until} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND evaluation_no=#{evaluation} AND state='PENDING'
